_opis: Katalog funkcji MindSync = odpowiednik katalogu produktow PLASMET. Zrodlo prawdy dla bramki pokrycia (scripts/blog-coverage-preflight.py) i kart CTA [FEATURE:] w tresci wpisow (scripts/webflow/blog-publish.ps1). ZWERYFIKOWANY z kodem obu repo 2026-08-25 (inwentaryzacja Explore: routery FastAPI + ekrany/nawigacja Flutter), nie ze strona www (nieaktualna). Utrzymuje operator + backend-api przy zmianach w apce. Statusy: live (osiagalne w apce, mozna linkowac), beta (jest, ale kruche/ukryte - karta RYZYKO), planned (nie linkowac, temat = BRAK/RYZYKO).
_zasada: Wpis nigdy nie prowadzi w slepy zaulek: gdy brak funkcji, CTA idzie do celu pochodnego (inna funkcja) albo do strony zbiorczej z site_targets. Braki dopisujemy do docs/luki-funkcji.md. NIE obiecujemy w tresci funkcji o statusie planned, nawet jesli strona www je reklamuje.

features.name: Session recording & summaries
features.short: Record a session with your therapist's permission and get a summary card with the questions your therapist asked, to-dos, threads and realizations.

features.name: Before therapy card
features.short: Before each session, a one-page card with a short summary of what came up since last time, up to three numbered questions to bring, to-do ideas, threads, patterns and your Focus Areas.
keywords: what to talk about in therapy

features.name: After therapy card
features.short: Note what you took away right after a session. The card keeps the summary, questions, to-dos and realizations, and after three sessions it adds Your progress in therapy, a chart of your own entries, not a score.

features.name: Between-session voice notes
features.short: Say it out loud when something comes up between sessions: voice notes are transcribed automatically, you review and accept the text.

features.name: Reflect (AI journaling)
features.short: Talk things through with Orca, MindSync's AI therapy assistant, in writing, or by voice on Premium. It asks the follow-up questions a blank journal never will, and past talks stay readable.

features.name: Focus Areas check-ins
features.short: Rate what you're keeping an eye on (sleep, worry, anything you pick) from 1 to 10. It takes under a minute.

features.name: Mood & focus-area trends
features.short: Focus Areas on Main chart your last 14 ratings for each area and describe the trend in plain words.

features.name: Weekly & monthly summaries
features.short: Automatic weekly and monthly summaries (with a Generate Now button when you cannot wait) that turn scattered entries into a readable story of your progress.

features.name: Therapy timeline
features.short: Every card, note, recording, realization and summary on one timeline with filters at the top, and a recycle bin for 24 hours.

features.name: Workspace
features.short: One place for the space between sessions: your agenda for next time, topics, to-dos, threads you keep pulling on, and the realizations worth keeping.

features.name: Homework & to-dos
features.short: Therapy homework lands on your home screen as a simple to-do for today, so it actually gets done instead of surfacing guiltily next session.

features.name: Therapy relationship check
features.short: A short check-in on how therapy itself is going, your working alliance with your therapist, with a result you can share.
keywords: is my therapist right for me

features.name: Goals
features.short: Set therapy goals, get suggestions from your own entries, and watch each goal accumulate evidence from sessions and check-ins.

features.name: Reminders you control
features.short: Thirteen notification types (prep, homework, reflections, summaries and more), each with its own switch, tuned to your therapy schedule.

features.name: Personal Bio
features.short: A living bio the app writes about you from your entries, shareable as a card.

features.name: Daily affirmation
features.short: A daily affirmation on your home screen that stays grounded and specific instead of fortune-cookie generic.

features.name: Streaks & milestones
features.short: Streak tracking exists in the backend but has NO user-facing UI today (celebrations removed in CS-04; Character tab has no streak widget). Do not promise in content. Per-habit day streaks live in Habits.

features.name: Share with your therapist (clinician portal)
features.short: Portal and consent flow are BUILT but the patient-side entry point was hidden in MSV3.4 (CS-11) as unfinished; feature is unreachable in the app. Do not promise in content until re-exposed, even though the marketing site advertises it.

features.name: Main home screen
features.short: MindSync opens on Main: eight tiles for your next session, Therapy Agenda, to-dos, the last seven days of your habits, Focus Areas, therapy relationship, weekly observations and a daily affirmation. A blue dot means something is waiting.

features.name: Your first week plan
features.short: New accounts get a plan of eight small steps on Main, a few minutes each and with no set days, from answering Orca's question to adding your next session, a voice note, a quick check-in and a short look back at the week. A reminder is optional and comes at most once a day.

features.name: First conversation with Orca
features.short: Right after sign-up, Orca, MindSync's AI therapy assistant for the days between sessions, asks three short questions by voice or in writing, then the conversation is yours. Orca isn't a therapist. Your first Before therapy card starts from what it heard.

features.name: What Orca remembers
features.short: A page in Settings that lists every note Orca keeps from your conversations and entries, grouped by what's on your mind, what helps, goals, routines and people. Delete any note, or tap Forget everything.

features.name: Character: strengths and skills
features.short: Six strengths (Courage, Insight, Honesty, Resilience, Kindness and Commitment) grow from moments in what you write and say, never from just opening the app. Your map shows the skills you're building under the feelings they help with. Tap Not quite on any moment that doesn't fit.
keywords: what you are learning about yourself

features.name: Habits
features.short: Track small daily things you want to do, or want to stay free of. The Habits tile on Main shows the last seven days, so you can still check off a day you missed.
